game_version.description: Minimum supported AI Manga iOS app version. Increase only after the matching version is available in the App Store.

apple_store_url.description: HTTPS apps.apple.com URL for this environment. Leave empty until its App Store listing exists; an invalid URL never blocks app use.

force_update_enabled.description: Require updating when game_version is newer than the installed app and apple_store_url is valid. Keep false until the store release is available.
